mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id as supplierId, supplier_name as supplierName, product, contact_number as contactNumber, email, return_policy as returnPolicy, on_the_way as onTheWay, COUNT(*) OVER () AS totalRows FROM v_supplier_list WHERE (CAST(#{search} AS text) IS NULL OR supplier_name ILIKE '%' || CAST(#{search} AS text) || '%' OR product ILIKE '%' || CAST(#{search} AS text) || '%') AND (CAST(#{return_policy} AS text) IS NULL OR CAST(return_policy AS text) = CAST(#{return_policy} AS text)) AND (CAST(#{only_on_the_way} AS boolean) IS NOT TRUE OR COALESCE(on_the_way, 0) > 0) ORDER BY supplier_name, product LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset};
